finding: Zones are SKU terciles from train-only statistics on the locked panel (no test leakage). Daily recursive primary bands are train volume-sum terciles (locked bake-off; ≈ mean-demand ranks). Weekly Direct-MH primary bands are train mean-demand terciles; secondary are train zero-rate terciles (high_zero = most intermittent). Daily: overall portfolio story holds but is zone-heterogeneous—TST leads short-horizon mid/high volume; DeepSequence leads long-horizon mid volume and h=60 low; high-volume long horizons often favor LightGBM on IWMAE/CumMAE. Weekly Direct-MH: DeepSequence wins mean-demand mid/high at all reported horizons and low volume at h≥4; TSB edges h=1 low-volume and some high-zero/mid intermittent one-step cells; DS dominates smoother (low_zero) weeks and longer H.
